minor.issue: Best-effort image thumbnail from pokemontcg.io intermittently returns 500/timeouts, causing image_url=null on the scan response. Not a regression — this external service has always been fallback-only. Consider caching last-known image_url per (name, number) in Mongo, or falling back to null silently (already happens) but the pytest assertion is too strict. Suggest loosening test_scan_pikachu image_url assertion to `image_url is None or startswith('http')` OR adding a retry in fetch_english_image.

action_items: (OPTIONAL, low-priority) Loosen test_scan_pikachu image_url assertion to tolerate None (pokemontcg.io is flaky and image_url is documented as best-effort in fetch_english_image). Alternatively add 1 retry with exponential backoff inside fetch_english_image.

(PRE-EXISTING, cosmetic) Two RN-web deprecation warnings still noisy in console: shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents. Not blocking; ignore or clean up when touching those components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:158 — VISION_MODEL correctly set to 'gemini-3-flash-preview'. Flash also used by grade_estimate at server.py:894 (both share VISION_MODEL constant → consistent).

server.py:214-227 — identify_card_with_vision try/except now case-insensitives the error message (`str(e).lower()`) and pattern-matches BOTH 'unable to process input image' AND 'invalid_argument'. Returning a synthetic {detected: False, not_ready_reason: ...} lets the existing not-detected branch at server.py:455-459 handle it cleanly — the UI shows the reasoning text and re-tries on the next auto-scan tick. Correct fix.

server.py:901-913 — grade_estimate mirrors the same defensive check but raises 422 instead of returning a fake success, which is the right semantic since the client explicitly requested a grade. The 422 will propagate to estimateGrade in api.ts:190-198 as a thrown Error — main agent should verify the grade-estimate UI shows a friendly message on 422 (didn't test that path here; needs a real bad image to reproduce).

api.ts:30-49 — AbortController pattern is correct. clearTimeout called in BOTH success and error paths. err.userMessage populated for the timeout case so UI can surface it. Only nit: on non-AbortError catch (e.g., network reset), userMessage is not set — UI will fall back to generic error handling. Acceptable.

api.ts:63-64 — for non-2xx (non-402) responses, err.userMessage='Scan failed — check connection.' is set consistently, so the scanner cannot get stuck on 'Identifying card…' text — the surrounding UI will replace the label with the error message (verified by the fact that the label state was correctly cleared to 'HOLD TO ASK' in iter14 smoke run).

settings.tsx:208 — 'Gemini 3 Flash' hardcoded string aligned with backend VISION_MODEL. If model ever gets bumped again, remember to update both this label AND perf_test.test_scan_latency's expected latency budget.
